# Remotly

> Remotly is a next-generation remote connectivity platform offering secure remote access, work collaboration, and game streaming with enterprise-grade encryption and low-latency performance.

Remotly provides comprehensive remote access solutions for both professional work environments and entertainment use cases, supporting Windows, Android, and Linux platforms with advanced security features including AES-256 encryption and secure relay infrastructure.

## Key Topics

- Remote Access
- Remote Desktop
- Game Streaming
- AES-256 Encryption
- Low-Latency
- 4K HDR
- Remote Work
- Remote Support
- Windows/Android
- Voice Chat
- File Transfer
- Session Recording
- Secure Infrastructure
- NAT Traversal
- Business Support

## Getting Started

- [Remotly Homepage](https://remotly.com): Homepage for Remotly remote access software with AES-256 encryption
- [Download Remotly](https://remotly.com/download): Download Remotly for Windows, Android, and Linux platforms
- [Getting Started with Remotly for Windows PC](https://remotly.com/tutorials/getting-started-with-remotly-for-windows-pc): Getting started guide for Remotly Windows PC installation and setup

## Core Features

- [Work Remotely](https://remotly.com/work-remotely-remote-support): Remotly remote work solution with voice/video chat and low-latency access
- [Play Remotely](https://remotly.com/play-remotely): Remotly game streaming for Windows/Android with 4K HDR support
